definitions: To leave an unpleasant memory or impression.
To cause a feeling of disgust, disappointment, or resentment.
examples: The whole experience left a bad taste in my mouth.
His rude comments really left a bad taste in the mouth of the audience.
The way they handled the situation left a bad taste in the mouth for many employees.
lemma: leave a bad taste in the mouth
source: left a bad taste in the mouth
